title: Dana Whitfield: bare restatement of a readback value confirms it (hand-built, live finding)
description: Hand-built from tonight's live barge-in rehearsal (report scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-11T22-51-38-barge-in-interrupt.md, deploy 20): the agent read back the beneficiary five times ("Just to confirm, the beneficiary is Meridian Supply. Is that correct?") and the caller answered "Meridian Supply." every time -- the exact read-back value, verbatim -- with no affirm/negate lexicon word at all. Before the ledger.ts fix (this branch), that reply resolved nothing: critical_fields_confirmed stayed false and the live call looped until idle timeout (then-row-14, now row 15, ESCALATE). This recording is otherwise identical to scenario-a-dana-legitimate.json (same identity, tools, live checks, and challenge -- all already proven to reach STAGE on their own) with only the final caller line changed from "Yes, that's right." to "Meridian Supply.", isolating the one behavior this fix changes: a bare exact restatement of a readback value now counts as CONFIRMED. Proves the fix reaches STAGE on the live transcript shape that used to ESCALATE.
